hints.title: Grid Directed Transitions
hints.text: Every cell can transition only to right or down neighbors with strictly greater values.

hints.title: Sort Cells by Value
hints.text: Sorting cells in descending order ensures no cycles, allowing forward accumulation of paths.

hints.title: Memoized Path Count
hints.text: paths(r, c) = 1 + sum(paths(nr, nc)) for strictly increasing valid right or down neighbors.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Each cell is computed once in DAG traversal.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Traversing paths without memoization causes exponential branching.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Memoization cache uses O(m * n) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects DAG structure recognition and memoized DFS on grid.
